purpose: Scope manifest for scripts/ci/check-docs-links.mjs (slice S17 of the full-site-repair-2026-09-12 packet).
principle: The link check guards maintained documentation: pages a reader is expected to navigate today. Frozen historical records and vendored upstream bundles are excluded because their content must not be rewritten, and link-checking them produces a permanent red signal that cannot be cleared. Excluded files are STILL CHECKED; only their failure is downgraded from a gate failure to a recorded, shrink-only debt. Every exclusion must match a declared frozen class, and neither the excluded file count nor the excluded dead-link count may grow.
checkedScope: Every git-tracked *.md file that is not matched by an excludedPaths entry.

classes.vendored upstream content: Installed from an upstream repository and recorded by hash; editing it falsifies the hash and is overwritten on the next install.
classes.archive-only historical record: Retained as a historical record. Its content describes a past state and must not be rewritten. Where a directory is still an active write target, the entry additionally pins frozenAsOf so that only pre-existing files are debt.
classes.QA artifact / generated output: Written by a script in this repository. Its links are whatever the generator emitted.
